example.title: Yacht clubhouse on the harbour front (Balboa Yacht Club)
example.place: Corona del Mar, Newport Beach, Orange County, CA

brief: A 1980s yacht clubhouse on the harbour edge: a long two-storey white-painted clubhouse with a grey-blue hipped roof and gabled end pavilions, a glazed upper dining room, a covered ground-floor terrace, a flagpole with signal yard, and dinghy racks and sailing dinghies on the dock in front. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
